attested in context

  • CURIE: gmeow:attestedInContext
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestedInContext
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/lexicon
  • Box roles: CBox role, RBox role (What is this?)

The corpus, platform, community, dataset, inscription, or broader context in which the attested form was observed. NON-FUNCTIONAL: a form may be attested in multiple contexts simultaneously, and context assignments are standpoint-scoped.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:UsageAttestation -> gmeow:Entity

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:attestedInContext from gmeow:UsageAttestation to gmeow:Entity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:UsageAttestation, gmeow:Entity

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use on a UsageAttestation to name the corpus, platform, community, dataset, or inscription context in which the form was observed.

Avoid when

  • Avoid treating context as the asserting standpoint (it is deliberately not subsumed under vantage — context is where it was seen, not who claims it) and avoid using it for the bibliographic source (gmeow:attestedInSource).

How to use

  • Point gmeow:attestedInContext at one or more gmeow:Entity contexts; multiple coexisting contexts on one attestation are expected, and the asserting standpoint stays on the vantage axis.

Examples

  • ex:att1 gmeow:attestedInContext ex:chaucerCorpus.
